SecurityPoolFactory

Deploys every security pool from pinned creation code and module deployers, and deploys and registers their question ledgers and shared price feeds. No standalone deployment entry point exists. SecurityPoolFactory source contract

Read surface

Each question derives its start bond as max(1 REP, universe theoretical REP supply / 10,000,000). questionLedgerDeploymentCount and strict questionLedgerDeploymentsRange enumerate canonical question ledgers. isSecurityPool is true only for a security pool this factory deployed, and securityPoolCreationCodeHash is the hash of the only creation code it deploys. securityPoolCount and strict securityPoolsRange enumerate, in registration order, the factory-deployed security pools that have configured their namespace; a deployed security pool is listed when its final setup step calls initializeSecurityPoolPriceFeed. getQuestionLedgerId, getQuestionLedger, getQuestionLedgerOriginId and getQuestionLedgerHasInheritedForkOutcome identify their lineage. getQuestionOriginId includes the caller security pool namespace. securityPoolOf returns the factory-deployed security pool a ledger belongs to; sharedPriceFeeds is indexed by security pool and universe. maximumReportCollateral exposes the largest collateral report floor whose escalation halt fits the oracle amount domain. maximumReportPriorityFeeAttoEthPerGas exposes the configured feed-factory ceiling used to reject over-cap security pool creation before setup. zoltar identifies the protocol root.

State-changing interactions

The contract index defines the columns.

Transaction Caller Main prerequisites State or asset effect Primary signals
deploySecurityPool(creationCode, configuration) Anyone keccak256(creationCode) equals securityPoolCreationCodeHash (Security pool creation code is not canonical); configuration is exactly 13 words (Security pool configuration length invalid). The security pool constructor’s own checks apply and revert the deployment, including that every pinned module deployer holds code. Deploys a SecurityPool whose leading constructor arguments are this factory and its nine pinned module deployers, records it in isSecurityPool, and returns its address. The deployment uses CREATE2 with a salt derived from the caller and the number of security pools that caller has deployed, so the address depends on its creator and no other deployment can occupy it. configuration is the ABI encoding of the origin configuration, question horizon, admission policy and economics, in that order: the only values the creator chooses. SecurityPoolDeployed with the security pool and the caller. Setup continues through the security pool’s prepareNext.
initializeSecurityPoolPriceFeed(universeId, priorityFee) A security pool this factory deployed, within its own caller-address namespace The universe has a REP token and has not forked. A repeated call must match the first call’s REP token and priority fee. The feed starts without an accepted price. The caller satisfies isSecurityPool (Security pool is not canonical), so no other contract can open a namespace. This call neither registers a question nor allocates REP. The first call creates the caller namespace’s oracle configuration from the universe’s REP token and the priority fee, and appends the caller to the security pool registry. Each call creates the namespace’s feed for that universe or returns the existing one. Security pool setup calls this in its last stage, before any question is admitted. Returns the canonical feed address. The first setup emits SecurityPoolRegistered. Each new feed emits SharedPriceFeedRegistered with the security pool, universe and feed address.
initializeSecurityPoolPriceFeedForUniverse(universeId) A security pool, within its own caller-address namespace The caller has configured its namespace; the caller’s security pool clock recognizes the target universe; the target REP token exists. Creates or retrieves the caller namespace’s feed for an already registered child universe, using the oracle configuration from the namespace’s first initializeSecurityPoolPriceFeed call. No question needs to be deployed first. Returns the canonical feed address. A newly deployed feed emits SharedPriceFeedRegistered.
prepareSecurityPoolPriceFeed(source, universeId) Anyone Canonical source question ledger registered to a security pool; the security pool clock recognizes the target; the target REP token exists. Creates or retrieves a target universe feed in the canonical source question ledger’s security pool namespace without moving provider capital. Returns the canonical feed address. A newly deployed feed emits SharedPriceFeedRegistered.
deploySecurityPoolQuestionLedger(universeId, questionId, statoblastSecurityMultiplierBps, initialReportPriorityFeeAttoEthPerGas) A security pool with a configured namespace, within its own caller-address namespace The caller has configured its namespace (Security pool configuration missing), which only a factory-deployed security pool can do. The ordinary origin deployment checks apply; no lineage for this question/configuration has been claimed in the caller namespace. The namespace is derived from msg.sender and cannot be supplied on behalf of another security pool. Creates a separate origin ledger and share token in the caller namespace, referencing the canonical namespace/universe shared REP/collateral feed. Security pool admission calls this from the security pool contract, after its immutable admission policy allows the question; it then enforces the question horizon, with failure reverting deployment. QuestionLedgerRegistered and DeployQuestionLedger
prepareSecurityPoolChildPriceFeed(parent, outcomeIndex) Anyone The parent is a canonical question ledger in PoolForked state. Its namespace and oracle configuration determine the feed; Zoltar determines the selected child universe and its REP token. Prepares the child universe’s REP token and shared feed in a separate transaction before creating a child question ledger. Repeated preparation returns the same feed without moving capital or selecting any owner’s migration. Returns the canonical child feed address. A newly deployed feed emits SharedPriceFeedRegistered. Child REP deployment may emit Zoltar events.
deployChildQuestionLedger(parent, shareToken, universeId, questionId, statoblastSecurityMultiplierBps) QuestionForker only (Only question forker) Parent is the canonical question ledger for its lineage; supplied share token equals the parent share token; no question ledger has already been claimed for the parent origin in the target universe; a security pool child feed has already been prepared; deployment arguments satisfy downstream constructors and wiring. Creates and registers a canonical child question ledger with the parent share token and its canonical security pool branch feed. QuestionLedgerRegistered, then DeployQuestionLedger
